results.comment: Oh my god, Kratos's extreme change in the tone of his voice when he says "Atreus!" at 1:37:34 is so sweet. It's just SUCH a huge change, and it wasn't necessarily because he was concerned for Atreus's safety (though of course he was); we've heard that plenty before. The change in tone here is from concern, knowing what taking a human's life would do to his boy.   And even more so, after he's pulled the man off of him and Atreus starts to cry, the way he holds his little head in his huge scarred hands to comfort him...it's just SO FREAKING SWEET, omg I can't stand it!!! 🥰🥰   This is like the fourth or fifth time I've rewatched jack's playthrough of this game, yet it still gets me every damn time. One of my most most favorite tropes is when a huge, hulking, powerful character shows gentleness and love to someone they care deeply for, one who is so much smaller and weaker than they are, whom they will protect at all costs...and GOD HELP YOU IF YOU HURT THEM.
